name: ModelVariant821_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant821_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (three volleys of up to ten bolts leave model points on the active slot every period and fly towards the opposing slot or the ground near it, each wrapped in a ring of sprites and spinning Gouraud strips and trailing a ribbon and a pair of flares; a bolt that lands bursts into animated sparks, rising smoke and falling debris while the ambient green and blue dim and recover); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the bolts and packs five image descriptors (0-4) into six retained texture page/CLUT words, descriptor 3 being packed again with blend mode 2 into word 3 and with mode 1 into word 5, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the start time, 4 once the first bolt has landed, 1 once when the last bolt of each volley has landed after the end time, 2 once the ambient has recovered and the last bolt of each volley has faded and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-838 and 935 images build it from the same source with the US layout. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
